correctness.rationale: A constant Itô solution must have zero diffusion coefficient, so with common nonzero noise \(\sigma(x,y,z)\) only the origin qualifies. The face \(Y=Z=0\) is invariant and gives \(dX=-k_A X\,dt+\sigma X\,dW\), hence a lognormal solution with \(P(X_t>1)>0\) for every \(X_0\in(0,1)\), \(t>0\), \(\sigma>0\). For the paper's values \(\pi=30,r_A=1/6,u=0.6,a=2\), \(k_A=6/5\) and the modified A-drift at all-join is \(19/5\), not zero. A fresh numerical replay also reproduced the package's illustrative escape probability \(0.1957956706626627\).
